system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:46 UTC, dana.wells opened Invoice_Nov_2026.docm from her Downloads folder in Microsoft Word.
About two seconds later, Word launched PowerShell as its child with -nop, -w hidden, and an encoded command, under dana.wells's account.
The encoded command decodes to an expression that executes content returned by DownloadString from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nb-tools/ps-utils/main/upd.ps1.
The proxy recorded a successful HTTP 200 GET for that exact GitHub script URL, associated with PowerShell's proxy connection.
PowerShell then launched rundll32 with the command line targeting C:\Users\dana.wells\AppData\Roaming\msupd.dll,Start; the rundll32 process subsequently terminated.
PowerShell ran from 13:39:48 to 13:40:11 UTC, matching the reported brief PowerShell appearance around 13:40 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the command line and proxy request, but do not include the downloaded script's contents or a hash of that content.
The records show rundll32's command line but do not establish whether the DLL loaded successfully or what it did.
The supplied interval and event types do not establish whether the activity created persistence, accessed data, or affected other systems.
